title: Vasicek Diffusion Bridge for Graph Generation
abstract: arXiv:2611.30605v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Diffusion-based graph generation models progressively transform Gaussian noise into structured graphs through stochastic dynamics. We observe that the effectiveness of this transformation is fundamentally determined by the evolution of the diffusion trajectory. Existing graph diffusion models often suffer from excessive uncertainty during diffusion and delayed growth of the signal-to-noise ratio, causing useful structural information to emerge only in the later stages of generation. To address this issue, we propose the Vasicek Graph Diffusion (VGD), a graph diffusion process derived from the Vasicek dynamics. The key insight of VGD is data-anchored mean dynamics with a closed-form solution, which analytically establishes a continuous transition from Gaussian noise to the target graph distribution. translated_abstract: 基于扩散的图生成模型通过随机动力学将高斯噪声逐步转化为结构化的图。我们观察到，这种转化的有效性从根本上取决于扩散轨迹的演化。现有的图扩散模型往往在扩散过程中存在过大的不确定性，且信噪比增长滞后，导致有用的结构信息仅在生成的后期阶段才显现。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了Vasicek图扩散（VGD），这是一种源自Vasicek动力学的图扩散过程。VGD的关键洞察在于具有闭式解的数据锚定均值动力学，它从解析层面建立了从高斯噪声到目标图分布的连续过渡。与主要依赖随机演化的传统图扩散过程不同，VGD引入了一个数据锚定的漂移项，该漂移项……
tldr: 本文提出基于Vasicek动力学的图扩散模型VGD，利用具有闭式解的数据锚定均值动力学，从解析上建立高斯噪声到目标图分布的连续过渡，解决了现有图扩散模型不确定性过大、信噪比增长滞后导致结构信息过晚出现的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Vasicek Graph Diffusion (VGD), which leverages data-anchored mean dynamics with a closed-form solution to analytically establish a continuous transition from Gaussian noise to the target graph distribution, addressing excessive uncertainty and delayed signal-to-noise ratio growth in existing graph diffusion models.
